lookup_lexicon — MV classify op

• Data kinds: table → scalar

• Call: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.lookup_lexicon(lexicon, word) (to call the implementation directly, import mvclass; mvclass.lookup_lexicon(lexicon, word); from the registry, opsmv.get("lookup_lexicon"))

• HALCON equivalent: lookup_lexicon (the HALCON reference is a useful guide to its meaning and parameters)

• GPU: none (CPU reference implementation only)

Usage

Check whether a word is in the list by exact match and return 1.0 if so, otherwise 0.0.

> The detailed description below is the original text — the summary and the headings are translated.

空の入力(word が空文字)は ValueError。

Args:

lexicon: create_lexicon の返り。

word: 調べる語。

Returns:

一覧にあれば 1.0、無ければ 0.0。
